concepts.definition: A group of jobs with similar tasks.
A shared dictionary of occupations and the skills they need.

questions.q: What is the difference between an occupation and a job?
questions.a: An occupation is a group of similar jobs, and a job is a position at one employer.

questions.q: Why use a classification and job postings together?
questions.a: A classification is stable and comparable, while postings show current employer needs.
